angle: Completion, not access, is the actual bottleneck
hook: The free AI courses actually worth finishing
caption:
There are hundreds of free AI courses and almost nobody completes one. The problem was never finding material — it is that most of it is built to be started, not finished. These are the ones with an end, a project, and something to show at the bottom.

💬 Comment "COURSE" and I'll send you the full list.
🔖 Save this for the next time you need it.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#aicourses #learning #upskilling #freeeducation #careergrowth #aitools

slides.text: The free AI courses actually worth *finishing*
slides.subline: Access was never the problem. Finishing is

slides.text: You do not have a course problem. You have thirty hours of half-watched lectures and nothing built.

slides.title: Pick one with a project
slides.body: A course that ends in something you built beats a course that ends in a video. If there is no artefact at the end, you will not remember any of it in a month.

slides.caption: the typical completion rate for a free online course

slides.title: Book it like a meeting
slides.body: Two fixed hours on the same two evenings each week, in the calendar, treated like something you cannot move. Motivation will not survive week three. A calendar entry will.

slides.title: Ship the project publicly
slides.body: Post whatever you built at the end, however rough. It is the only part that turns a finished course into work someone can actually hire you for.

slides.text: Save this before you need it
slides.subline: Send it to someone still paying for this
